description: This Java interface defines configuration properties for a JavaScript Message Mapper, including methods to retrieve and set scripting options and library loading flags.

classes.name: JavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration interface for JavaScript message mapping, providing optional scripts and library load flags.

classes.name: JavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration.Builder
classes.description: Builder interface for constructing JavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration instances with configurable scripts and library loading options.

methods.name: getIncomingScript
methods.description: Returns an optional string containing the incoming message mapping script.

methods.name: getOutgoingScript
methods.description: Returns an optional string containing the outgoing message mapping script.

methods.name: isLoadBytebufferJS
methods.description: Determines if the 'bytebuffer.js' library should be loaded.

methods.name: isLoadLongJS
methods.description: Determines if the 'long.js' library should be loaded.

methods.name: incomingScript
methods.description: Sets the incoming message mapping script; null to remove.

methods.name: outgoingScript
methods.description: Sets the outgoing message mapping script; null to remove.
